text:
sami_t: quick idea: instead of jamming full billing_id into every span record, emit a short stable fingerprint at the edge and use a rehydrate service for full joins later.
leena_m: how short are we thinking? 8 bytes? 12? need collision math for our 10B/day scale.
sami_t: thinking 12-16 bytes hex (96-128 bits). collision prob << 1e-9 for our tenant universe. will run exact numbers.
omar_r: operational concerns: extra work on proxy for HMAC/KDF per request - cost at 50k rps? also where do we store salt/keys?
sami_t: compute cost is tiny if we use keyed blake2b or siphash variant; bench shows ~200ns/op in C. keys live in KMS + cached in proxy instances, rotated weekly.
leena_m: sampling interaction: if edge samples out full payload, we still need fingerprint for aggregate billing. do we preserve it on sampled-out stubs?
cas sie_p: yes preserve. header looks like: 
```
X-RW-Bill-Fp: v1=fa3d9b1c2e7a
X-RW-Bill-Cohort: coh-7
```
leena_m: okay. what about late enrichment? rehydration service must be bounded (latency + cache).
omar_r: design: LRU cache on rehydrator + fallback queue. cache hit -> immediate join. miss -> async fill + mark record with `billing_fp_unresolved`. analytics queries can aggregate with `fp` while long-tail joins consult rehydration table offline.
sami_t: we should also emit a metric `billing.fp.unresolved` and `rehydrator.cache.hit_rate`. put SLO on rehydration p50 < 5ms, p95 < 100ms for online path.
leena_m: privacy: fingerprint must be irreversible. use HMAC(key, tenant_id || env_salt) then trunc. document key handling + rotation semantics.
cas sie_p: collusion risk if two tenants intentionally craft ids to collide? attacker would need key to craft HMAC - with key secrets safe we good. add monitoring for anomalous fp frequencies.
omar_r: index size implications: we replace high-cardinality `billing_id` column with fixed-length `billing_fp`. queries looking up full billing info do 1: many join to rehydration table. rough model: save ~40 bytes per event, but add rehydration table of K entries (tenants) small.
sami_t: migration plan: 1) accept `billing_fp` in staging but keep `billing_id` 2) run side-by-side attribution (10% of traffic) 3) compare dashboard deltas and unresolved rate 4) expand to all traffic 5) after 30d of stability, mark `billing_id` deprecated and backfill historical data into `billing_fp` through offline rehash where possible.
leena_m: queries: add compatibility helpers in our analytics client so users can `SELECT billing_group(fp)` while dashboards are updated. create docs + one-liners for common reports.
cas sie_p: failure modes: rehydrator KMS outage -> fp still valid for aggregation, but joins fail. plan: degrade gracefully: tag unresolved and fallback to `billing=unattributed` for critical billing-run. also provide manual backfill path using tenant manifests.
omar_r: monitoring checklist: fp computation latency, proxy CPU delta, rehydrator cache hit rate, unresolved fraction, collision detectors (fp -> count of distinct billing_ids), index size delta.
obs-bot: created JIRA RW-OBS-2037 "billing fingerprint + rehydration follow-up" and assigned to @sami_t.
sami_t: i'll draft RFC addendum with exact fingerprint format, KDF choice, rotation model, rollout checklist, and perf numbers. will ping for review.
leena_m: SGTM. small ask: include a short query cookbook for migrating dashboards.
sami_t: will do. thanks all.
